data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 13.3 million for the 2016 financial year, primarily driven by favourable settlements in 2016 on the 2013 and prior years' liability reserves. This contributed to a profit arising from the reinsurance to close received from the 2013 year of account. However, there was also an emergence of some new sources of claims in the liability book, leading to some strengthening in net claims provisions for Liability Reinsurance, while other lines like Accident & Health, Property, Third Party Liability, and Property Reinsurance experienced net releases.
raw_causal_phrases: substantial release of reserves from prior years of account now available due to the continuing favourable trends experienced during the last few years in incurred claims development on all years of account
recent emergence of some new sources of claims in the liability book

strengthening of the third party liability reserves during 2015, was a consequence of it becoming clear that changes to the policy wordings given to contractors were not producing the forecast ultimate loss ratios
strengthening of the liability reinsurance reserves during 2016 reflects the recent emergence of some new sources of claims in the liability book

data.data_quality_notes: The LOB movements for prior year development are reported as net of reinsurance, as gross figures were not available at the individual line of business level. The overall prior year development figure of GBP 13.3m is a gross profit from RITC, which implies a release, and is explicitly stated as arising from a reduction in prior years' liability reserves. The claims development triangle shows a different total prior year movement (-GBP 7.098m), likely due to different scope (all open years vs. specific closed year RITC profit) or accounting for exchange rate movements. The RITC profit figure is taken as primary due to its explicit mention as a reduction in prior years' liability reserves.
